{{Top|leg}}
The '''Fan Master''' was the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] responsible for maintaining the giant air entry ducts and fan housings in the city of [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. The Fan Master and his extended family cleaned ducts and maintained the fans to ensure that the ducts and air caves beneath the city were free of debris. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the position of Fan Master was held by [[Elam'shak]].
